How old is {place}?
The {civ} laid the first stones of {place} {era}, around the year {year}. We have been here ever since.
{place} goes back {era} - {year} or near enough - when the {civ} came up the valley and stopped.
Why the walls?
{place} put its walls up {era}. Around {year}, and nobody builds walls for the first fright.
Has {place} ever been taken?
The {civ} came through {place} {era} and took what they liked. The {foe} could not hold it.
Around {year}. The {civ} in the streets of {place}, and whatever the {foe} promised, no help coming.
What became of {place}?
They pulled {place} down {era}, somewhere around {year}. Nothing was rebuilt.
Why did {place} empty out?
{place} emptied {era}. People left one household at a time, and then there was nobody.
What happened at {place}?
The blight took the fields at {place}, and {era} - about {year} - there was no reason left to stay.
What happened to {place}?
The mountain took {place} {era}, around {year}. You can still walk into what is left of it.
Ash. All of it, in one night, {era}. {place} is under there somewhere.
Who are the {civ}?
The {civ} count their beginning from about {year}, at {place}. {era}, if that means more to you.
Whatever happened to the {civ}?
The {civ} came apart {era}, around {year}. There is nobody left to answer for them.
Has there been war?
The {civ} declared on the {foe} {era}, near enough {year}. It went on longer than anyone promised.
Any fighting near here?
The {civ} and the {foe} fought here {era}. The ground still turns up iron if you dig.
Around {year}, {era}. A bad day for the {foe}, a good one for the {civ}, and a worse one for whoever was farming it.
Was {place} ever besieged?
The {civ} sat outside {place} for the best part of a year, {era}, waiting for hunger to do the work.
Who holds {place} now?
The {civ} took {place} {era} - about {year} - and kept it.
Is there peace?
The {civ} and the {foe} signed {era}, around {year}. It has held, more or less.
Has sickness come through?
Plague in {place}, {era}. They burned the clothes and it went on spreading anyway.
Around {year} was the sickness. Ask anybody old enough and they will tell you who they lost.
Have the harvests ever failed?
{place} went hungry {era}, about {year}. Two bad harvests together is all it takes.
Does the water ever come up?
The water came into {place} {era}, around {year}. It has come close since, but not like that.
Is that mountain safe?
The mountain woke {era}, somewhere around {year}. Ash on everything for a season.
{era}. You could read by the light of it at midnight, and nobody slept.
Who leads the {civ}?
{figure} came up among the {civ} {era}, around the year {year}.
What became of {figure}?
{figure} of the {civ} died {era}, in bed, which is more than most get.
How did {figure} die?
{figure} of the {civ} fell in battle {era}. About {year}, if you want it written down.
Is the road safe?
{figure} of the {civ} went out into the waste {era} and never came back.
Around {year}. {figure} took the short way across and is buried wherever they fell.
Did anyone go and look?
{figure} walked out to the wound {era}. No grave, no word, nothing.
Is anything famous made near here?
{figure} made {artifact} {era}. Around {year}, they say, though they would.
Who carries {artifact}?
{artifact} passed to {figure} {era}. Not everyone thought it should have.
Was anything ever lost around here?
Something went missing {era} that people still come asking after. Nobody agrees where.
Where did {artifact} end up?
{artifact} went into the ground with {figure} {era}, around {year}.
Is there anything worth digging for?
The {civ} opened the workings above {place} {era}, around {year}. It changed what this country is for.
Is there a house of the faith nearby?
The {civ} founded the house out past {place} {era} - somewhere poor and hard to reach, as they do.
Who watches the frontier?
There is a fort on the high ground above {place}. The {civ} put it there {era}, around {year}.
What is the light on the headland?
The light stands off {place}. The {civ} first lit it {era} and it has not been dark since.
What is that stone for?
The {civ} raised it over {place} {era}, about {year}. Everybody argues about what it means.
Has anything changed in your lifetime?
The {civ} worked something new out {era}, around {year}, and the work has been easier since.
Where did the mana come from?
Something came down {era} - {year}, they reckon. Everything strange in this world starts there.
What is wrong with the land?
The corruption reached the fields at {place} {era}, about {year}. It does not go back.
Why is {place} still standing?
The {civ} raised wards at {place} {era}. That is the only reason anybody is still there.
What do people here believe?
The {civ} swore themselves at {place} {era}, around {year}, and meant it.
Was there ever a falling out over it?
The {civ} broke with what they had sworn, at {place}, {era}. It is still not forgiven.
What is the stone circle?
The {civ} raised it above {place} {era}, around {year}, to work at.
Do they still hold the rites?
The {civ} kept the rite {era}, about {year}. They keep it still, when it matters.
Quiet shift?
Quiet is the whole job. A shift you remember is a shift that went wrong.
You look tired.
New boots. Everyone says they wear in. Nobody says how long that takes.
Do the walls still hold?
They hold. Somebody's grandfather paid for them and I get to stand on them.
How is the temple?
The roof leaks over the east aisle. We pray a little further west in wet weather.
Busy morning?
Nobody has come in since dawn. That is either very good or very bad and I never learn which.
Is this weather an omen?
Half the town will ask me that today. The honest answer is that it is weather.
What is on today?
Small beer, and it is honest. The good barrel is not ready and I will not rush it.
How are the rooms?
Full. One of them snores like a saw and the other four have all told me so.
Business good?
Good enough that I turned two away last night. I am not used to saying that.
How is the barley coming?
Slow. It always looks slow to me and then it is suddenly all at once.
Much to do?
The north fence again. Something keeps going through it and I have never once seen what.
Good weather for it?
This is the rain you want, if it stops. It is the not stopping that ruins you.
Long day?
My back says so. My back has said so since I was twenty.
What are you hauling?
Stone, up the hill, all of it. Whoever drew the plan never carried anything.
Work in this cold?
Ground is frozen hard as iron. We dig anyway, just slower and for the same money.
Good spot?
Best corner in town. Everyone walks past it and nobody looks at it. Suits me.
Anyone bother you?
Only the dogs, and only because I feed them. My own fault entirely.
Are people generous here?
There is money in this town. Some of it even comes down as far as me.
What are you playing?
You have to get to the well without touching the ground. I am the best at it.
Shouldn't you be somewhere?
Letters. I can do most of them. I am not going back until someone makes me.
Cold enough for you?
It snowed! Nobody else is even excited. I do not understand grown people.
Do people fish here?
Off the point, when the tide is right. Half the town claims to know when that is.
Is the pass open?
It is, today. Ask again after the next weather and you may get a different answer.
Anything in the woods?
Wolves, they say. I have lived here forty years and heard them twice.
Is the river low?
Lower than it should be. The mill wheel is turning about half as fast as it likes.
Everything is mud.
Every year. Every single year, and every year we are all surprised by it.
Warm today.
Too warm to do anything and too bright to sleep. I will not complain again until tomorrow.
Ready for the cold?
Getting the stores in. It is never quite as much as you remember needing.
Enough firewood?
Enough if it breaks early. It has not broken early in my lifetime.
Who built the walls?
People who are all dead now. We live behind them and mostly forget they are there.
This place has seen trouble.
Once. You can still see where the old stone stops and the new stone starts.
Keeping well?
My knees tell me the weather now. They are more reliable than anyone in this town.
How is the work?
I fetch things. Three years of fetching, I am told, and then I get to hold a tool.
Has anything been happening?
Something big was killed out past the ridge. Folk went to look and came back quiet.
There was a thing out there. Somebody put it down. I have not been out that way since.
